detail.overview: The Ant Esports GS510 Multimedia 2.0 Channel USB Powered RGB Gaming Speakers with Control pod - Black is a premium multimedia speaker designed to deliver excellent performance for gaming, music, and multimedia. Featuring an output of 2 x 5w, 2.0 Channel configuration, and Micro SD (Reader), USB-A (Power), 3.5mm (Audio) connectivity, it ensures reliability, durability, and compatibility with modern devices. Whether you are upgrading your audio setup or adding sound to your workspace, it provides dependable performance and essential functionality. Backed by 1 Year Limited, it's an excellent choice for gamers, music lovers, and everyday users.
